rows.task_shape: CODE: implement an already-planned slice of code and run its test
never: claude-haiku-5-5: trails both larger models on most agentic coding benchmarks (on one vendor long-context benchmark it edges the mid-tier), so use it only for one-file edits a larger model will check
any model at max effort: flat or lower on code-editing benchmarks for several times the cost (the sonnet-max persona runs only when asked)

rows.task_shape: BREADTH: search and fetch fan-outs, collecting (even for a decision), and browser, command-line or tool-server loops
never: claude-haiku-5-5: its best tool-automation score sits below the mid-tier's lowest effort, and at low effort in long agent prompts it skips searches and checks
claude-fable-5-1: costs several times as much for a lower tool-automation score

rows.task_shape: READ: extract, classify, summarise or digest text or files that are handed over, in a few tool calls
never: claude-haiku-5-5: never for facts from memory, tool loops, code, ops, security, regulated work, final deliverables or gates
claude-haiku-5-5 at xhigh or max: xhigh can end a chat turn with no visible text and max spends several times the output tokens of high

rows.task_shape: BUILD: a code, configuration or infrastructure change with no obvious shape, an irreversible change, or work a worker already failed
never: claude-haiku-5-5: far behind on hard repository tasks
any model at max effort: no gain over xhigh for the top tier and a higher bill

rows.task_shape: GATE: final pass, verification, judging or tie-break on finished work
never: claude-haiku-5-5: its vendor documents reporting a change as done without running a check, and it over-refused most in the vendor's audit

rows.task_shape: RESEARCH: multi-source synthesis and web research that needs judgment
never: claude-haiku-5-5: factual recall far below the larger models
claude-fable-5-1: about twice the cost for a slightly lower web-research score, so use it only when asked for by name

rows.task_shape: OPS: anything run on a machine, such as shell work, runbooks, container and service changes, and diagnostics
never: claude-haiku-5-5: far below the larger models on terminal-task benchmarks
any model at max effort: no better than xhigh on terminal tasks for a higher bill

rows.task_shape: DELIVERABLE: a final document, deck or spreadsheet for a person or a third party (internal drafts: researcher)
never: claude-haiku-5-5: fine for an internal first draft, but it trails the larger models on every deliverable benchmark, so it never writes the final version

rows.task_shape: SECURITY: review code, configuration or an environment for vulnerabilities
never: claude-haiku-5-5: its cyber safeguards trigger on security work and it has no fallback, so the task stalls or is refused

rows.task_shape: REGULATED: legal, tax, medical or compliance work; cite primary sources, then pass the result to blue-verify
never: claude-haiku-5-5: last on every legal, tax and medical benchmark it is listed on
claude-fable-5-1: leads the max-only legal and tax benchmarks at several times the cost, so offer it and never route to it by default

rows.task_shape: RED: adversarial review or pre-mortem on a different model from the builder; attacks, never gates
GREEN: an independent alternative design or rebuild from a different model than the builder
